public_declarations.name: Agent101.reverse_wrapDigits
public_declarations.declaration_head:
theorem reverse_wrapDigits (a b : Nat) (xs : List Nat) :
    (wrapDigits a b xs).reverse = wrapDigits b a xs.reverse

public_declarations.name: Agent101.exists_coefficientWord_of_reverse
public_declarations.declaration_head:
theorem exists_coefficientWord_of_reverse (q : List Nat)
    (hq : q.reverse = q) : ∃ h c, q = coefficientWord h c

public_declarations.name: Agent101.coefficientWord_half_length
public_declarations.declaration_head:
theorem coefficientWord_half_length (h : List Nat) (c : Option Nat) :
    h.length = (coefficientWord h c).length / 2

public_declarations.name: Agent101.digitFn_coefficientWord_cons_zero
public_declarations.declaration_head:
theorem digitFn_coefficientWord_cons_zero (s : Nat) (h : List Nat)
    (c : Option Nat) : digitFn (coefficientWord (s :: h) c) 0 = s

public_declarations.name: Agent101.digitPairSums_reverse
public_declarations.declaration_head:
theorem digitPairSums_reverse (ds : List Nat) :
    (digitPairSums ds).reverse = digitPairSums ds

public_declarations.name: Agent101.digitPairSums_profile
public_declarations.declaration_head:
theorem digitPairSums_profile (ds : List Nat) :
    ∃ h c, digitPairSums ds = coefficientWord h c ∧
      h.length = ds.length / 2 ∧
      (coefficientWord h c).length = ds.length

public_declarations.name: Agent101.digitPairSums_profile_cons
public_declarations.declaration_head:
theorem digitPairSums_profile_cons (ds : List Nat) (hL : 2 ≤ ds.length) :
    ∃ s h c, digitPairSums ds = coefficientWord (s :: h) c ∧
      h.length = ds.length / 2 - 1 ∧
      (coefficientWord (s :: h) c).length = ds.length ∧
      s = DecimalDigits.columnSum (digitFn ds) ds.length 0

public_declarations.name: Agent101.mem_numericFiber_of_same_width_step
public_declarations.declaration_head:
theorem mem_numericFiber_of_same_width_step (ds h : List Nat) (c : Option Nat)
    (hd : canonicalDigits ds) (hp : digitPairSums ds = coefficientWord h c)
    (n : Nat) (hw : decimalWidth n ds.length)
    (hs : step n = step (natValue ds)) : n ∈ numericFiber h c

public_declarations.name: Agent101.fixed_width_profile_length_le
public_declarations.declaration_head:
theorem fixed_width_profile_length_le (ds h : List Nat) (c : Option Nat)
    (hd : canonicalDigits ds) (hp : digitPairSums ds = coefficientWord h c)
    (ns : List Nat) (hns : ns.Nodup)
    (hm : ∀ n ∈ ns, decimalWidth n ds.length ∧ step n = step (natValue ds)) :
    ns.length ≤ profileCount h c

public_declarations.name: Agent101.profileCount_cons_outer_le
public_declarations.declaration_head:
theorem profileCount_cons_outer_le (s : Nat) (h : List Nat) (c : Option Nat) :
    profileCount (s :: h) c ≤ pairCount true s * 10 ^ h.length

public_declarations.name: Agent101.fixed_width_preimages_outer_bound
public_declarations.declaration_head:
theorem fixed_width_preimages_outer_bound (Y L n s : Nat) (d : Nat → Nat)
    (hc : Canonical n d L) (hL : 2 ≤ L) (hs : step n = Y)
    (ho : columnSum d L 0 = s) (ns : List Nat) (hns : ns.Nodup)
    (hm : ∀ x ∈ ns, decimalWidth x L ∧ step x = Y) :
    ns.length ≤ pairCount true s * 10 ^ (L / 2 - 1)

public_declarations.name: Agent101.fixed_width_preimages_bound
public_declarations.declaration_head:
theorem fixed_width_preimages_bound (Y L : Nat) (ns : List Nat)
    (hL : 2 ≤ L) (hns : ns.Nodup)
    (hm : ∀ n ∈ ns, decimalWidth n L ∧ step n = Y) :
    ns.length ≤ 9 * 10 ^ (L / 2 - 1)

public_declarations.name: Agent101.one_digit_preimages_bound
public_declarations.declaration_head:
theorem one_digit_preimages_bound (Y : Nat) (ns : List Nat) (hns : ns.Nodup)
    (hm : ∀ n ∈ ns, decimalWidth n 1 ∧ step n = Y) : ns.length ≤ 1

public_declarations.name: Agent101.MaximumWitnesses.mem_maximumPreimages_fixed
public_declarations.declaration_head:
theorem mem_maximumPreimages_fixed (D n : Nat) :
    n ∈ maximumPreimages D ↔ decimalWidth n D ∧ step n = maximumTarget D

public_declarations.name: Agent101.MaximumWitnesses.maximumPreimages_nonempty
public_declarations.declaration_head:
theorem maximumPreimages_nonempty (D : Nat) (hD : 2 ≤ D) :

public_declarations.name: Agent101.MaximumWitnesses.mem_maximumPreimages
public_declarations.declaration_head:
theorem mem_maximumPreimages (D : Nat) (hD : 2 ≤ D) (n : Nat) :
    n ∈ maximumPreimages D ↔ 0 < n ∧ step n = maximumTarget D

public_declarations.name: Agent101.MaximumWitnesses.all_width_maximum_witness
public_declarations.declaration_head:
theorem all_width_maximum_witness (D : Nat) (hD : 2 ≤ D) :
    ∃ Y : Nat, ∃ ns : List Nat,
      decimalWidth Y D ∧ ns.Nodup ∧
      (∀ n, n ∈ ns ↔ 0 < n ∧ step n = Y) ∧
      ns.length = 9 * 10 ^ (D / 2 - 1)

public_declarations.name: Agent101.MaximumWitnesses.one_digit_preimages
public_declarations.declaration_head:
theorem one_digit_preimages (n : Nat) :
    n ∈ ([1] : List Nat) ↔ 0 < n ∧ step n = 2

public_declarations.name: Agent101.MaximumWitnesses.one_digit_maximum_witness
public_declarations.declaration_head:
theorem one_digit_maximum_witness :
    ∃ Y : Nat, ∃ ns : List Nat,
      decimalWidth Y 1 ∧ ns.Nodup ∧
      (∀ n, n ∈ ns ↔ 0 < n ∧ step n = Y) ∧ ns.length = 1

public_declarations.name: Agent101.Maximum.width_bound_mono
public_declarations.declaration_head:
theorem width_bound_mono (L K : Nat) (hLK : L ≤ K) :
    9 * 10 ^ (L / 2 - 1) ≤ 9 * 10 ^ (K / 2 - 1)

public_declarations.name: Agent101.Maximum.two_width_bound_arithmetic
public_declarations.declaration_head:
theorem two_width_bound_arithmetic (D a b : Nat)
    (ha : a ≤ 8 * 10 ^ ((D - 1) / 2 - 1))
    (hb : b ≤ 10 ^ (D / 2 - 1)) :
    a + b ≤ 9 * 10 ^ (D / 2 - 1)

theorem all_width_preimages_bound (Y D : Nat) (ns : List Nat)

public_declarations.name: Agent101.Maximum.all_width_inverse_maximum
public_declarations.declaration_head:
theorem all_width_inverse_maximum (D : Nat) (hD : 2 ≤ D) :
    (∀ (Y : Nat) (ns : List Nat), decimalWidth Y D → ns.Nodup →
      (∀ n ∈ ns, 0 < n ∧ step n = Y) →
      ns.length ≤ 9 * 10 ^ (D / 2 - 1)) ∧
    (∃ (Y : Nat) (ns : List Nat), decimalWidth Y D ∧ ns.Nodup ∧
      (∀ n, n ∈ ns ↔ 0 < n ∧ step n = Y) ∧
      ns.length = 9 * 10 ^ (D / 2 - 1))

public_declarations.name: Agent101.Maximum.one_digit_inverse_maximum
public_declarations.declaration_head:
theorem one_digit_inverse_maximum :
    (∀ (Y : Nat) (ns : List Nat), decimalWidth Y 1 → ns.Nodup →
      (∀ n ∈ ns, 0 < n ∧ step n = Y) → ns.length ≤ 1) ∧
    (∃ (Y : Nat) (ns : List Nat), decimalWidth Y 1 ∧ ns.Nodup ∧
      (∀ n, n ∈ ns ↔ 0 < n ∧ step n = Y) ∧ ns.length = 1)
